title: Dihydrotanshinone I inhibits the growth of hepatoma cells by direct inhibition of Src.
authors: Jiang, Xiao-Li; Deng, Bo; Deng, Sui-Hui; Cai, Min; Ding, Wen-Jun; Tan, Zhang-Bin; Chen, Rui-Xue; Xu, You-Cai; Xu, Hong-Lin; Zhang, Shuang-Wei; Zhang, Shi-Qing; Liu, Bin; Zhang, Jing-Zhi
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DHI通过抑制Src激酶活性抑制肝癌细胞生长，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer-related death worldwide. Dihydrotanshinone I (DHI) was shown to inhibit the growth of several types of cancer. However, research related to hepatoma treatment using DHI is limited. PURPOSE: Here, we explored the inhibitory effect of DHI on the growth of hepatoma cells, and investigated the underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: The proliferation of Hep3B, SMCC-7721 and SK-Hep1 hepatoma cells was evaluated using the MTS and Edu staining assay. Hepatoma cell death was analyzed with a LIVE/DEAD Cell Imaging Kit. The relative expression and phosphorylation of proto-oncogene tyrosine-protein kinase Src (Src) and signal transducer and activator of transcription-3 (STAT3) proteins in hepatoma cells, as well as the expression of other protein components, were measured by western blotting. The structural interaction of DHI with Src proteins was evaluated by molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, surface plasmon resonance imaging and Src kinase inhibition assay. Src overexpression was achieved by infection with an adenovirus vector encoding human Src. Subsequently, the effects of DHI on tumor growth inhibition were further validated using mouse xenograft models of hepatoma. RESULTS: In vitro studies showed that treatment with DHI inhibited the proliferation and promoted cell death of Hep3B, SMCC-7721 and SK-Hep1 hepatoma cells. We further identified and verified Src as a direct target of DHI by using molecular stimulation, surface plasmon resonance image and Src kinase inhibition assay. Treatment with DHI reduced the in vitro phosphorylation levels of Src and STAT3, a transcription factor regulated by Src. In the xenograft mouse models, DHI dose-dependently suppressed tumor growth and Src and STAT3 phosphorylation. Moreover, Src overexpression partly abrogated the inhibitory effects of DHI on the proliferation and cell death in hepatoma cells. CONCLUSION: Our results suggest that DHI inhibits the growth of hepatoma cells by direct inhibition of Src.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。二氢丹参酮I（DHI）已被证明可抑制多种类型癌症的生长。然而，关于DHI用于肝癌治疗的研究有限。目的：本研究探讨了DHI对肝癌细胞生长的抑制作用，并研究了其潜在的分子机制。方法：使用MTS和Edu染色实验评估Hep3B、SMCC-7721和SK-Hep1肝癌细胞的增殖情况。使用LIVE/DEAD细胞成像试剂盒分析肝癌细胞死亡。通过蛋白质印迹法测量肝癌细胞中原癌基因酪氨酸蛋白激酶Src（Src）和信号转导与转录激活因子-3（STAT3）蛋白的相对表达和磷酸化水平，以及其他蛋白组分的表达。通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、表面等离子体共振成像和Src激酶抑制实验评估DHI与Src蛋白的结构相互作用。通过感染编码人Src的腺病毒载体实现Src过表达。随后，使用小鼠肝癌异种移植模型进一步验证DHI对肿瘤生长的抑制作用。结果：体外研究表明，DHI处理抑制了Hep3B、SMCC-7721和SK-Hep1肝癌细胞的增殖并促进了细胞死亡。我们通过分子模拟、表面等离子体共振成像和Src激酶抑制实验进一步鉴定并验证了Src是DHI的直接靶点。DHI处理降低了体外Src和STAT3（一种由Src调控的转录因子）的磷酸化水平。在异种移植小鼠模型中，DHI剂量依赖性地抑制了肿瘤生长以及Src和STAT3的磷酸化。此外，Src过表达部分消除了DHI对肝癌细胞增殖和细胞死亡的抑制作用。结论：我们的结果表明，DHI通过直接抑制Src来抑制肝癌细胞的生长。
